A secondary pattern: complete retrieval with wrong generation (e.g., 2hop__95878_88628) where the model extracts a surface entity (John Wayne) instead of answering the compositional query (role played). The embeddings and index are functional—they found spans in successful cases—but the interaction between aggressive query decomposition, small chunks (256 tokens), and a weak generator creates cascading refusal. The reranker (bge-reranker-v2-m3, top_n=10) may be filtering out late-hop evidence that embedding retrieval surfaced but the reranker deemed irrelevant to the decomposed sub-queries.
